content.heading: Ahoy — I'm Dean.
content.body:
I’m Dean Satterfield, your cruise advisor and Virgin Voyages First Mate. I love the places a cruise can take you—and helping you feel ready to enjoy every moment.

Whether you want help from the first idea or prefer to do your own planning, I’m here when you need me. You bring the excitement. I’ll bring a helping hand.

Want to join me on a future sailing? [Come travel with me →](/travel-with-dean/).
content.photoAlt: Dean relaxing in a red hammock aboard a cruise ship

items.q: Dean is exceptional at doing everything in his power to make you happy! He works with you and your group to help make your trip/cruise memorable!
Dean on Deck scored me the best deals on multiple Virgin voyages! Whenever he's on the ship, Dean makes time to ensure my experience is unforgettable and full of excitement.
Very good experience having Dean take care of my travel arrangements, would definitely use again and recommend.

way1.title: Book it yourself
way1.body: Choose your own sailing through my Virgin Voyages link, with Dean attached as your First Mate. I’m here if you request a helping hand.

way2.title: Plan it with me
way2.body: Tell me your destination, dates and cruise style. We’ll find the right fit and confirm the booking route for your chosen cruise line.

items.q: Does it cost extra to have Dean help me?

body.h: Planning at no cost to you
body.text: My cruise planning and support come at no cost to you. Cruise fares, taxes, supplier charges and any change or cancellation fees still apply.

items.q: Can I still book and plan on my own?

body.text: For Virgin Voyages, use my Let’s Go Book link so I’m attached as your First Mate. For other lines, contact me before booking to confirm how your reservation can be connected to my agency.

items.q: Can you help with a cabin change or a different sailing?

body.h: A helping hand when you ask
body.text: If I’m attached to your booking, I can help with requested changes. Availability, fare rules and any supplier fees determine what is possible.

Atlantis advised me that travelers who booked directly within the past four years generally must keep booking directly. Contact me so we can confirm your eligibility. When calling Atlantis, request Dean Satterfield at On Deck Agency.

items.q: I already booked. Can I add Dean?

body.h: Virgin Voyages: within 30 days, and not paid in full
body.text: Already booked a Virgin Voyages cruise? If your reservation was created within the past 30 days and hasn’t been paid in full, you can request to add me as your First Mate. Contact me promptly so I can help arrange the transfer with Virgin Voyages.
Transfer rules vary by supplier, booking date and payment status. Contact me before making changes, and I’ll help you check eligibility.

content.heading: Every detail designed *for adults.*
content.lede: No kids' menus. No water slides. Just Michelin-inspired dining, world-class wellness, and sea days made entirely for the grown-up escape.

items.d: Every sailor is 18 or over. No exceptions — just pure grown-up freedom, bow to stern.
20+ included restaurants, zero buffets, and not a single tray in sight.
Thermal suites and treatments tuned to long days at sea.
VIP Mega Rockstars from the terminal on — private decks, a personal agent, the works.
A private balcony, a hammock, and a cold drink as the coast rolls by.
Slow mornings and a horizon that changes every day.

content.imageAlt: The scarlet-hulled Virgin Voyages ship at sea
content.heading: Virgin reinvented what cruising means.
content.lede: Smaller ships. Bolder design. An energy that feels more boutique hotel than floating buffet — and absolutely no one under 18.
checklist: Kid-free sailings with a genuinely sophisticated crowd
Michelin-inspired dining included — no surcharges, no buffets
Stylish, modern ships built by designers, not committees
Premium entertainment and a real after-dark scene
Wellness-forward: spa, fitness, and sea-air everything

content.heading: RockStar perks, *handled.*
content.lede: RockStar Quarters are Virgin's VIP experience — and it starts the moment you reach the terminal. I'll match you to the right tier and lock in the early booking windows.
coreItems: Richard's Rooftop — private sundeck, bar & nightly happy hour
A dedicated RockStar Agent for dining, shows & requests
Priority dining (120 days) & Shore Things (135 days)
VIP boarding through a private entrance + priority off
In-room bar — first round of full-size bottles on the house
Private section at the Beach Club at Bimini
megaItems: Unlimited drinks up to $25 + two bottles of wine daily
Bottomless in-room bar, replenished every day
Private transfers within 50 miles, or port parking

content.heading: Where shall we point *the bow?*
content.lede: A few of the routes sailors love. Dreaming of Iceland, Alaska, or somewhere off the map? Just ask — I'll chart it.

content.heading: Unforgettable Virgin Voyages.
content.lede: Discover captivating adventures beyond the waves — every photo below is from Dean's own sailings.

items.alt: Dean in a helmet and harness on a zipline platform above the Dominican Republic coast
items.d: Itineraries that showcase hidden gems and must-see spots — think the Dominican Republic, done right.

items.alt: Dean on a Santorini terrace with the caldera and a Virgin ship anchored below
items.d: Exclusive sailing experiences aboard Virgin Voyages with premium amenities and stunning ocean views. Greece, anyone?

items.alt: A glass of champagne beside the printed tasting menu at Test Kitchen on board
items.d: Savor local flavors with gourmet dining experiences crafted by top chefs on and off the ship.

items.alt: Dean on a canal boat gliding past the gabled houses of Amsterdam
items.d: Engage with the rich history and vibrant culture of every region through guided tours and local interactions. Amsterdam awaits.

items.alt: Feet up on the warm deck at Sky Lagoon, looking out over the still Icelandic sea
items.d: Relax and rejuvenate with yoga, spa treatments, and meditation. Sky Lagoon, Iceland is calling.

items.alt: Dean in a snorkel mask reaching toward the camera in the turquoise water off Anguilla
items.d: Snorkeling, hiking, and more — tailored to your interests and skill level. Anguilla sets the bar.

content.heading: Notes from the *latest sailings.*
content.lede: Ports I've walked, tours I've tested, nights worth staying up for — straight from Dean's deck log, camera roll included.

items.alt: A waterfall thundering into a green gorge outside Seattle
items.d: Seattle is incredible — Pike Place Market and the Space Needle define the skyline, and beyond the city you'll find breathtaking waterfalls and a world-class culinary scene.

items.alt: Dean dockside in front of the Swiftsure catamaran in Port Townsend
items.d: Out of Port Townsend, the Swiftsure is a high-speed, wave-piercing catamaran with a wrap-around viewing deck — prime territory for getting up close with the whales.

items.alt: Dean beside the carved eagle at the Sitka, Alaska welcome sign
items.d: Wildlife cruises past sea otters, whales, and bears; an Alaskan seafood feast at Fin Island Lodge; kayaking glacier-carved fjords. A bucket-list stop — book Shore Things early.

items.alt: Dean in red light under the Scarlet Night neon sign on board
items.d: Virgin's ship-wide immersive party replaces stuffy formal nights — pop-up performances, flash mobs, and acrobatics, ending in a late-night pool party. Express yourself.

items.alt: Dean's selfie beneath the Space Needle against a clear blue sky
items.d: A must-see that truly stands out. From the scenery to the atmosphere, it's the kind of place that stays with you long after you leave.

items.alt: Dean waving from the pier with a Virgin Voyages ship towering behind him
items.d: Nothing beats touching down somewhere new. Meeting people and diving into vibrant cultures enriches life in ways words can't capture. Now it's your turn to chase the horizon.
